findings.evidence: `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go:222` sets `isPointPlan=true` when `stmt.PointGet.Executor != nil` and does `Get(cacheKey, nil)`; `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go:247` skips `checkPreparedPriv` when `isPointPlan` is true; `pkg/planner/optimize.go:510` `OptimizeExecStmt` does not perform privilege/table-lock checks and relies on plan-cache path; `pkg/session/session.go:2142` executes point plan short path (`stmt.PointGet`) when `stmt.PsStmt != nil`, with no additional privilege enforcement.
findings.fix: Do not skip `checkPreparedPriv` for PointGet cache hits (always run it), or add an equivalent fast privilege+table-lock recheck for the PointGet short-path before returning a cached plan/executor. Keep the “no MatchOpts” optimization separate from privilege enforcement.
findings.impact: Prepared EXECUTE statements that hit the session plan cache via PointGet short path can bypass runtime privilege recheck and table-lock checks after privileges/locks change (e.g., REVOKE in another session), leading to unauthorized visibility or lock-rule violations.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed later: upstream `master` at `b75374faa619e24e380292fdbdf0f6fe5bf11943` still derives `skipPrivCheck` from `stmt.PointGet.Executor != nil` (`pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go:227` in upstream/master view) and conditionally skips `checkPreparedPriv` (`pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go:304` in upstream/master view).
findings.verify: Add a regression test: user A prepares a PK PointGet statement (to enable point short path), executes it enough times to populate `stmt.PointGet.Executor` and get a plan-cache hit, then user/root revokes SELECT on the table; next EXECUTE must error. Also add a variant under `LOCK TABLES` / table-lock scenario to ensure lock checks still apply on cache hits.
findings.what: PointGet plan-cache hit path skips `checkPreparedPriv` (privilege + table-lock checks) once a cached PointGet executor exists (`stmt.PointGet.Executor != nil`), enabling prepared EXECUTE to proceed without runtime privilege/table-lock enforcement on cache hits.

subject: planner: fix small regression caused by #53094 (#53646)
summary: Changes plan-cache lookup to special-case PointGet (allow `matchOpts=nil` and bypass MatchOpts matching) and simplifies `GetMatchOpts`’s signature. This commit also conditionally skips `checkPreparedPriv` for cached PointGet hits, which can bypass runtime privilege/table-lock enforcement on prepared EXECUTE cache hits.
